title: Close session-start races: one task per user and the global cap
description: Two simultaneous POST /session calls can both pass the list-then-RunTask check and exceed one task per user or the cap of 3. Tasks stop on idle so damage is bounded. Fix with a conditional write (DynamoDB) or reserved concurrency if it matters in practice.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Races narrowed by duplicate cleanup but not atomic; stays open.

right_now_summary: Session-start races are narrowed by cleanup, but requests can still create duplicate tasks and exceed the cap.
